karpathy.en: Andrej Karpathy reviewed Project Hail Mary film, praising its faithful adaptation of Andy Weir's book and the thoughtful alien design with rich scientific details; he notes the movie leans slightly toward superhero pacing but excels at character relationships and the central bromance.
karpathy.zh: Andrej Karpathy 评价《火星救援》电影对 Andy Weir 原著的忠实改编和精心设计的外星人设定，包含丰富的科学细节；他指出电影在超级英雄式节奏方面有所倾斜，但在角色关系和核心关系刻画上表现出色。

swyx.en: Swyx advocates giving designers direct access to coding agents, arguing this dramatically improves both productivity and design quality while revealing how much developers were previously slowing designers down.
swyx.zh: Swyx 主张给设计师直接访问编码 agent 的权限，认为这能大幅提高生产力和设计质量，同时暴露了开发者之前对设计师效率的阻碍。

joshwoodward.en: Josh Woodward announced a fix for Gemini's Android voice feature, allowing users to pause mid-speech without the app interrupting prematurely; iOS support coming in a few weeks.
joshwoodward.zh: Josh Woodward 宣布 Gemini Android 语音功能修复，用户可在说话中暂停而不会被应用过早打断；iOS 支持将在几周内推出。

petergyang.en: Peter Yang outlines OpenAI's strategy: leverage ChatGPT's dominant installation base, enhance it for coding and knowledge work, then evolve it into a personal assistant (like OpenClaw) that adapts to individual users before competitors capture those use cases.
petergyang.zh: Peter Yang 概述 OpenAI 的策略：利用 ChatGPT 最大的安装基数，增强其编码和知识工作能力，然后演进成个人助手（如 OpenClaw）在竞争对手抢占这些应用场景前满足用户需求。

thenanyu.en: Nan Yu sarcastically comments that Forbes 30 Under 30 list remains consistently fraudulent.
thenanyu.zh: Nan Yu 讽刺评论 Forbes 30 Under 30 榜单持续欺诈性。

AmandaAskell.en: Amanda Askell humorously suggests getting married again so the media has fresher personal details to reference when covering her or her work.
AmandaAskell.zh: Amanda Askell 幽默地建议再次结婚，这样媒体在报道她或她的工作时有更新鲜的个人细节可以参考。

trq212.en: Thariq announced Claude Code channels feature, enabling control of Claude Code sessions through select MCPs starting with Telegram and Discord, allowing direct messaging from mobile devices.
trq212.zh: Thariq 宣布 Claude Code channels 功能，允许通过包括 Telegram 和 Discord 在内的 MCP 控制 Claude Code 会话，支持从移动设备直接消息传递。

amasad.zh: Amjad Masad 发送开斋节问候。

levie.en: AI agents will monotonically increase compute budgets for workers who master them across all knowledge work domains—from lawyers and marketers to sales reps—shifting AI spending from IT budgets to business unit ownership, making CFOs potential heads of AI strategy.
levie.zh: 掌握 AI agent 的员工将看到计算预算持续增长，从工程扩展到法律、营销和销售等所有知识工作领域——将 AI 支出从 IT 预算转向业务部门所有权，使 CFO 有可能成为 AI 战略负责人。

ryolu_.zh: 前沿智能，成本低，速度快——Composer 2 交付。

garrytan.en: Easter egg: Garry Tan embedded a YC reference into his /office-hours skill.
garrytan.zh: 彩蛋：Garry Tan 在 /office-hours 技能中嵌入了 YC 参考。

mattturck.en: Benedict Evans discussion explores OpenAI's moat challenges, the shift toward ephemeral and improvised software powered by agents, and how the AI industry is moving beyond simple chatbot interfaces to complex agent-driven workflows.
mattturck.zh: Benedict Evans 讨论深入探讨 OpenAI 的护城河挑战、向临时性和即兴软件的转变（由 agent 驱动），以及 AI 行业如何超越简单的聊天机器人界面转向复杂的 agent 驱动工作流。

nikunj.en: The momentum-obsessed culture in VC and startup ecosystems—marked by data manipulation, poor due diligence, and unchecked growth—is showing signs of finally reversing as market gravity reasserts itself.
nikunj.zh: VC 和创业生态系统中痴迷于动量的文化——以数据操纵、尽职调查不力和无节制增长为特征——正显示出最终逆转的迹象，市场重力重新发挥作用。

danshipper.en: Every just published a definitive guide to writing high-quality prose with AI assistance, offering practical techniques for crafting better content.
danshipper.zh: Every 发布了关于使用 AI 辅助编写高质量文案的权威指南，提供了编写更好内容的实用技巧。

Data Driven NYC.en: Benedict Evans argues that OpenAI faces a critical strategic problem: while foundation models lack network effects, OpenAI has massive mindshare but only 5% of its 900M weekly users are paying customers, using the platform just one mile wide and an inch deep. Without a sustainable moat, the company is attempting to build durable ecosystems above the commodity models—through partnerships, integrations, and applications—but faces challenges competitors like Meta and Google don't, as they can embed LLMs into existing profitable businesses. The real question isn't whether better models solve the problem (they don't, since most use cases accept 80-90% accuracy), but whether OpenAI can transform mindshare into locked-in developer ecosystems before other organizations leapfrog their models.
Data Driven NYC.zh: Benedict Evans 指出，OpenAI 面临一个关键的战略问题：虽然基础模型缺乏网络效应，但 OpenAI 拥有巨大的心智份额，却只有 5% 的 9 亿周活用户是付费客户，用户基数很广但深度很浅。在缺乏可持续护城河的情况下，OpenAI 试图通过合作、集成和应用程序在商品化模型上建立持久的生态系统，但面临 Meta 和 Google 不存在的挑战，因为后者可以将 LLM 嵌入现有的盈利业务中。真正的问题不是更好的模型是否能解决问题（实际上不能，因为大多数用例都接受 80-90% 的准确率），而是 OpenAI 能否在其他组织不断超越其模型之前，将心智份额转化为锁定的开发者生态系统。
Data Driven NYC.takeaway_en: OpenAI's moat isn't in models—it's in building an irreplaceable platform ecosystem before commodity LLMs make all models interchangeable.
Data Driven NYC.takeaway_zh: OpenAI 的护城河不在模型本身——而在于在商品化 LLM 使所有模型可互换之前，建立一个不可替代的平台生态系统。
